title: A month without Earth
summary: In the month when Earth is least in view, robots that share jobs and roads among themselves let {{r:with_urgent}} urgent items wait more than a day and need {{r:with_hand}} of hand coordination from Earth; without the network {{r:without_urgent}} urgent item waits more than a day and road conflicts take {{r:without_hand}} of coordination by hand.
summary_plain: In the month when Earth is least in view, robots that share jobs and roads among themselves let 0 urgent items wait more than a day and need 0.0 h of hand coordination from Earth; without the network 1 urgent item waits more than a day and road conflicts take 8.7 h of coordination by hand.
notes: Fifth story (F-56). Numbers: results/ATC_trace_pair_summary.json (B-80c: the with/without pair of B-80, July 2028, one seed) and results/E48_sizing.json (Earth visibility that month). The story player shows the pair for steps with modes.view = atc_pair (run = with / without / both; at = start / end / hand / auction; play); world:P2 is only the schema-valid default scene. Status draft until the story player's pair view has been checked in a browser; wording for LEAD to edit.

base_dte.source: results/E48_sizing.json: revision/two_ray_in_the_mesh/e40_month/base_dte_share; x 100; share of the month with Earth above the base's horizon; the least of the year (the month the trace pair shows)
base_dte.label: Earth in view of the base, that month

loss.source: results/ATC_trace_pair_summary.json: runs/with/settings/loss; x 100; per-hop loss set for the run with the network
loss.label: Message loss on the mesh

without_urgent.source: results/ATC_trace_pair_summary.json: runs/without/summary/urgent_items_waiting; urgent items that arrived this month and waited more than 24 h (the trace's own definition)
without_urgent.label: Without: urgent waits over a day

with_urgent.source: results/ATC_trace_pair_summary.json: runs/with/summary/urgent_items_waiting; urgent items that arrived this month and waited more than 24 h (the trace's own definition)
with_urgent.label: With: urgent waits over a day

without_hand.source: results/ATC_trace_pair_summary.json: runs/without/summary/earth_hand_hours; operator hours spent settling road conflicts by hand through Earth in the month

steps.title: The month Earth is least in view
steps.text: In the simulated year shown, the base sees Earth least in July: {{r:base_dte}} of the time. For the rest of the month no control room on Earth can reach a rover directly.
steps.visual: The base from above in July, with the Earth chip showing when Earth is in view and when it is hidden.
steps.title_plain: The month Earth is least in view
steps.text_plain: In the simulated year shown, the base sees Earth least in July: 53 % of the time. For the rest of the month no control room on Earth can reach a rover directly.
steps.visual_plain: The base from above in July, with the Earth chip showing when Earth is in view and when it is hidden.

steps.title: Without the network
steps.text: Each company's control room on Earth assigns its own robots while Earth is in view, and road conflicts are settled by hand through Earth: {{r:without_hand}} of hand coordination this month. {{r:without_urgent}} urgent item waits more than a day for a rover.
steps.visual: Robots of one company stand idle while another company's cargo waits; a road conflict waits for Earth to rise.
steps.text_plain: Each company's control room on Earth assigns its own robots while Earth is in view, and road conflicts are settled by hand through Earth: 8.7 h of hand coordination this month. 1 urgent item waits more than a day for a rover.
steps.visual_plain: Robots of one company stand idle while another company's cargo waits; a road conflict waits for Earth to rise.

steps.title: With Lunar ATC
steps.text: The robots auction pooled jobs among themselves over the radio mesh, with {{r:loss}} of messages lost on each hop, and reserve the roads together. Hand coordination through Earth: {{r:with_hand}}. Urgent items that wait more than a day: {{r:with_urgent}}.
steps.visual: Radio links between the robots, reserved road segments in colour, and jobs passing to whichever robot can finish them soonest.
steps.text_plain: The robots auction pooled jobs among themselves over the radio mesh, with 10 % of messages lost on each hop, and reserve the roads together. Hand coordination through Earth: 0.0 h. Urgent items that wait more than a day: 0.
steps.visual_plain: Radio links between the robots, reserved road segments in colour, and jobs passing to whichever robot can finish them soonest.

steps.title: Fewer idle hours
steps.text: Across the fleet, robots sit idle {{r:with_idle}} with the network against {{r:without_idle}} without it: {{r:idle_saved}} less in one month.
steps.visual: The two months side by side on one clock, with the idle robots of each marked.
steps.text_plain: Across the fleet, robots sit idle 5,532 h with the network against 5,642 h without it: 110 h less in one month.
steps.visual_plain: The two months side by side on one clock, with the idle robots of each marked.

steps.title: What it costs, and what this is
steps.text: The network talks: about {{r:with_msgs}} messages an hour across the whole fleet, a light load on the radio. This is one simulated month and one seed, a picture of the idea rather than a result; the papers give averages over thousands of simulated years.
steps.visual: The message counter beside the two months; a note that this is a single run.
steps.title_plain: What it costs, and what this is
steps.text_plain: The network talks: about 2.2 messages an hour across the whole fleet, a light load on the radio. This is one simulated month and one seed, a picture of the idea rather than a result; the papers give averages over thousands of simulated years.
